scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,client "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:apps: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix server test
